## Early life
Usher Raymond IV[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-PeopleBio-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-5) was born on October 14, 1978,[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-6) in [Dallas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dallas "Dallas"), Texas.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-swe-7) His parents are [Jonnetta Patton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonnetta_Patton "Jonnetta Patton") ([née](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%A9e "Née") O'Neal) and Usher Raymond III.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-9) He spent the majority of his childhood in [Chattanooga, Tennessee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chattanooga,_Tennessee "Chattanooga, Tennessee"). Usher III left the family when his son was a year old,[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-ReidKing-10) and reconciled with him shortly before dying in January 2008.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-AboutParents-11)
Usher IV has a younger half-brother, James Lackey, from Jonnetta's marriage to Terry Patton, and grew up with the three of them.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-AboutParents-11) Directed by his mother, he joined the local church youth choir in Chattanooga when he was nine years old. There, his grandmother discovered his ability to sing, although it was not until Usher joined a singing group that she considered he could sing professionally.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-ReidKing-10) Believing that a bigger city would provide greater opportunities for showcasing him, Usher's family moved to [Atlanta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atlanta "Atlanta"), [Georgia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Georgia_\(U.S._state\) "Georgia \(U.S. state\)"), where there was a more conducive environment for beginning singers.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-Driven-12) While in Atlanta, he attended [North Springs High School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Springs_Charter_School_of_Arts_and_Sciences "North Springs Charter School of Arts and Sciences").[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-13)
